hero.tagline: Create your own story in the stars ✨

about.title: Every child has a story to tell
about.body: My Book Lab helps kids write, illustrate, and share their own stories — with built-in tools that make reading and writing fun and accessible for every learner.

story_buddy.title: AI Story Buddy
story_buddy.desc: A friendly writing assistant that gives ideas, not answers — encouraging kids to build their own stories.

illustrations.title: AI Illustrations
illustrations.desc: Turn any page into art with one tap. Kids see their words come to life as unique illustrations.

voice.title: Voice Input & Read Aloud
voice.desc: Speak your story or listen to it read back. Great for early writers and auditory learners.

focus.title: ADHD & Dyslexia Friendly
focus.desc: Sentence starters, word banks, visual progress maps, and gentle nudges keep kids focused without pressure.

classroom.title: Classroom Ready
classroom.desc: Teachers can create classrooms, collect student stories, and track writing progress.

accessibility.title: Built for All Learners
accessibility.desc: Adjustable fonts, high contrast mode, text-to-speech, and scaffolding tools support UDL and WCAG standards.

callout.title: Designed with every child in mind
callout.body: My Book Lab follows Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles and WCAG/COGA accessibility guidelines. Features like sentence starters, visual progress tracking, effort-based rewards, and multi-modal input are specifically designed to support children with ADHD, dyslexia, and other learning differences — making creative writing achievable and fun for everyone.

pricing.title: Plans & Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.
